message.content:
**Signatories of the United States Declaration of Independence**

| State | Signer(s) |
|-------|-----------|
| **Delaware** | George Read, Caesar Rodney, James McHenry |
| **Pennsylvania** | Robert Morris, Benjamin Rush, John Morton, George Clymer, William Whipple, George Taylor, Matthew Thornton, Joseph Hewes |
| **New Jersey** | Francis Hopkinson, Richard Stockton, John Witherspoon, Abraham Clark |
| **Georgia** | Button Gwinnett, Lyman Hall, George Walton |
| **Connecticut** | Roger Sherman, Samuel Huntington, Oliver Wolcott, Lewis Hylton |
| **Massachusetts** | John Hancock, Charles Carroll, Samuel Adams, Josiah Bartlett, Paul Revere, Elbridge Gerry, Stephen Hopkins, William Dawes |
| **Maryland** | Daniel Carroll, Edward Lloyd, Henry Lee, Frederick R. Baldwin |
| **South Carolina** | Arthur Middleton, Charles Pinckney, Pierce Butler, Thomas Heyward Jr., Thomas Lynch Jr. |
| **North Carolina** | William Hooper, Joseph Hewitt, John Penn |
| **Rhode Island** | Caleb Strong, Moses Brown, William Ellery |
| **Vermont** *(then part of New York)* | Ethan Allen, Ben Franklin (not an original signer; he later joined as a delegate from Pennsylvania), *Note*: Vermont did not send delegates until after ratification. |

> **Key points**
>
> - A total of **56 men** signed the document on July 2, 1776 (the day it was adopted).  
> - Some signatures were added later when additional states sent their representatives.  
> - Notable figures include **Thomas Jefferson** (author), **John Hancock** (first to sign, famously bold signature), **Benjamin Franklin**, **Samuel Adams**, and many others who played crucial roles in the Revolution.

If you’d like more details about each individual’s background or the circumstances surrounding the signing ceremony, let me know!
